stem: In children, which pathway is the more common cause of death before cardiac arrest?
explanation: Respiratory failure is the more common pathway. In children, death usually occurs through respiratory failure at about 60%, compared with circulatory failure at about 30%, before cardiac arrest.

citations.title: Recognition of the sick child: common ED presentations

rationale: Respiratory failure is the more common deterioration pathway listed in the draft; circulatory failure is the other major pathway mentioned.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because respiratory failure is the more common pathway and is listed at about 60%.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because circulatory failure is given as about 30%, not 60%.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because respiratory failure is given as about 60%, not 30%.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because raised intracranial pressure is not one of the two pathway percentages listed here.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because meningococcaemia is not the pathway described and is not given as about 30%.
